recipe.visualDefinition: A high-energy 3D character portrait featuring a stylized figure with a cylindrical LED-grid mask, set against a vibrant lime-green background with radial speed lines. The composition uses a low-angle perspective to emphasize the character, paired with heavy, blocky sans-serif typography layered over a bright pink banner.
coreVisualRelationships: High-contrast relationship between the lime green background and the hot pink text banner.
Interaction between the 3D character model and the flat, bold graphic text elements.
Visual rhythm created by the LED dot pattern on the mask echoing the circular shapes in the background.
coreInvariants: Cylindrical white mask with a grid of glowing circular lights.
Vibrant lime-green monochromatic background with subtle radial gradients.
Heavy, extra-bold sans-serif typeface for the primary display text.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The character is positioned centrally, cropped from the chest up, slightly tilted to the right to create dynamic tension.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The glowing LED mask serves as the primary focal point due to its brightness and central placement.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the glowing mask, move down to the large white display text, and finally rest on the pink informational banner.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample lime-green space around the head allows the character and text to pop without clutter.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Lime Green (Background) providing a high-energy, digital feel.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: White (Character and Display Text) for maximum legibility and brightness.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Hot Pink (Banner) used to highlight secondary information.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation across all primary colors with high value (brightness) to mimic a glowing screen effect.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid muted or earthy tones; stick to neon and digital-primary colors.

letterConstructionRules: Tight kerning for a compact, impactful look
characterSpecificRedesigns: None; relies on the weight and scale of the font for impact.

composition.position: Lower third, overlapping the character's chest
composition.scale: Large, spanning the width of the character

treatment.shadow: Subtle soft drop shadow for depth

composition.position: Bottom, inside a pink rectangular banner

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family used in two different weights and scales to maintain consistency.
graphicDevices: Radial speed lines/triangles in the background

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the gaming-industry standard for bold, high-impact display text.
Provides the necessary weight and vertical presence.
A geometric alternative that maintains the modern, clean look.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a 3D character render of a figure in a white tactical outfit wearing a white cylindrical mask with a glowing LED dot-grid pattern. The background should be a vibrant lime green with subtle radial speed lines emanating from the center.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, centered, white extra-bold sans-serif title in uppercase over the character's chest. Below it, add a horizontal hot-pink banner containing a secondary line of white bold sans-serif text in uppercase.

verificationChecks: Is the primary text extra-bold and uppercase?
Is the background a saturated lime green?
Does the pink banner provide a strong color accent at the bottom?
Is the character mask glowing with a dot-grid pattern?

mustRedesign: Exact facial features of the mask
postGenerationChecks: Ensure text is legible against the background and character.
Check that the pink banner is perfectly horizontal and centered.
Verify the glow effect on the mask is consistent with the lighting.
Confirm the speed lines do not distract from the main subject.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a high-detail 3D character portrait with a monochromatic neon background and two-tier bold sans-serif typography for a modern gaming aesthetic.
